title: Disney Store Recalls Toy Tool Sets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The tools contain eyes that can separate, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 20,000.

title: Nordica USA Recalls to Repair Skis; Binding Plates Can Break, Poses Fall Hazard to Skiers
summary: The binding plates could crack or break, causing the skier to lose control or fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 4,500 pairs.

title: Strangulation Death of a Child Prompts Hill Sportswear To Recall Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings
summary: The sweatshirts have drawstrings through the hood. The drawstrings should be removed immediately since they can become caught on objects and strangle a child. Units: About 120,000.

title: Outdoor Stoves Recalled by Jetboil Due to Burn Hazard
summary: A tight valve attached to the stove's fuel source can allow gas to leak, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 15,000.

title: ATVs Recalled By KTM North America Due to Brake Failure
summary: The rear brake caliper support can crack and the front brake operation can experience a loss of pressure, posing a risk of the rider losing braking and steering control and suffering injuries or death. Units: About 2,700.

title: Camp Stoves Sold Exclusively at Dick's Sporting Goods Recalled Due to Burn Hazard
summary: Gas could flow at a rate that would produce higher than expected flames. Rainwater in the burners can also prevent proper ignition and allow gas to build-up and ignite unexpectedly. These conditions pose burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 6,700.

title: Catalina Lighting Recalls Halogen Clamp Lamps Due to Fire and Burn Hazard; Sold Exclusively At Staples Stores
summary: The UV glass lens on the lamp can crack, exposing the halogen bulb, posing a fire and burn hazard. Units: About 2,000.

title: Golfer's Billiard Games Recalled by Dick's Sporting Goods and Golf Galaxy Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paints on the golf balls can contain excess levels of lead. Units: About 2,300.

title: Marzocchi Recalls Bicycle Forks Due to Crash Hazard and Risk of Injury during Repair
summary: The suspension system on bikes with the recalled forks could become completely compressed and fail to return to its original position after a forceful landing. This can cause riders to lose control of the bicycle and crash. The forks can also expand forcefully if repair is attempted by the consumer,

title: Intermatic Recalls Digital Timers Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The recalled timers can have a faulty ground connection, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 200,000.

title: The Land of Nod Recalls to Repair Cottage Bunk Beds Due to Fall Hazard
summary: When screws are missing from the upper bunk's guardrails, the vertical slats on the guardrails can detach and pose the risk of children falling when getting in or out of the upper bunk. Units: About 750.

title: Bicycles with R-SYS Wheel Rims Recalled by Mavic USA Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The spokes on the bicycle's front wheel rim can break during use, posing a fall and crash hazard to riders. Units: About 12,000.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts Recalled by Jerry Leigh of California Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The jackets have a drawstring through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: 1200.

title: Dorel Juvenile Group Recalls Safety 1st Stair Gates Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The hinges that hold the stair gate in place can break, posing a fall hazard to children if the gate is placed at the top of the stairs. Units: 100000.

title: Playland International Recalls Swing Sets Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The metal around the weld at the top of the swing frame can fail, causing the top bar to fall, posing a fall and impact hazard to the user or bystanders. Units: About 700.

title: Certain LG 830 "Spyder" Cell Phones Recalled For Upgrade Due to Dropped Connection or Poor Connection on Emergency 911 Calls
summary: The recalled phones can have difficulty sustaining a connection or have poor voice quality on calls to emergency 911. Units: About 30,000.

title: Salsa Bicycles Recalls Bicycles; Handlebar Stems Can Break Causing Rider to Fall
summary: The handlebar stems can crack or break, posing a fall hazard to the consumer. Units: About 8,600.

title: Various Toys Recalled by CBB Group Due to Choking Hazard and Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The fishing games, baby rattles and pull-a-long cars contain small parts, which can detach and pose a choking hazard to children. The mini pull back cars and bubble guns have surface paints which contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 39,000.

title: Air Venturi Recalls Air Rifles That Can Unexpectedly Fire, Posing Serious Injury Hazard
summary: The safety can fail, causing the rifle to unexpectedly fire. This poses a serious injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 50.

title: Silent Diving Systems Recalls Scuba Diving Hoses Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: Diving hoses may have been made without crimps, which can allow gas to leak or water to enter into the re-breather unit of the scuba diving equipment, posing a drowning hazard to the user. Units: About 820.

title: Old Navy Recalls Stuffed Toys; Button Eyes Can Detach and Pose a Choking Hazard to Young Children
summary: The stuffed toys have two button eyes that could detach from the toy, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 35,500 in the United States and 5,400 in Canada.

title: Compound Bows Recalled by BowTech Archery; Bow Can Unexpectedly Break Apart
summary: The ends of the bow's limbs can unexpectedly break during use and send fragments of the bow in the direction of the user or bystanders, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 8,000.

title: True Value Recalls Wheelbarrows; Over-Inflated Tire Can Cause Wheel to Break and Pose Injury Hazard
summary: Over-inflating the tire could cause the wheel's plastic rim to break, posing an injury to the user. Units: About 17,000.

title: Evenflo Recalls Children's Activity Centers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: When used as an activity table, the cap on one end of the product can loosen and fall off, posing a fall hazard to a young child. Units: About 213,000.
